name: Research-grade Single-point Tactile Sensor
summary: A flexible single-point pressure sensor family for robot tactile research and material-pressure measurements. Sycsense offers stretchable construction with customizable packaging and thickness. The manufacturer specifies a 0–2000 kPa detection range and response below 0.62 ms.
